description: Late filing penalties for a UK company's accounts (Companies House) and CT600 (HMRC): what is owed if filed on a given date, and the full schedule of dates when each penalty applies. Use with lookup_uk_company, which gives the accounts deadline. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD); filedOn defaults to today.

accountsDeadline.description: Companies House accounts deadline, ISO date

accountsLateLastYear.description: The previous year's accounts were also late: the Companies House penalty doubles.

ct600Deadline.description: CT600 filing deadline (12 months after the end of the accounting period), ISO date

ct600ThirdLateInARow.description: This is the third late CT600 in a row: each fixed penalty is GBP 1,000 instead of GBP 200.

filedOn.description: Date the filing arrives, ISO date. Defaults to today.

unpaidTax.description: Corporation tax still unpaid, in POUNDS, to estimate the 10% tax-geared penalties at 6 and 12 months.

name: uk_company_late_filing_penalties
